visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a grey baseball cap and a black t-shirt stands outdoors with a woman who has vibrant pink hair and is wearing a dark red shirt. They are filming in a selfie-style handheld shot, speaking directly to the camera with cheerful expressions. Behind them is a grey concrete structure and green trees under an overcast sky. (2) The scene cuts to a wide shot of the Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center Hall 1, a large modern grey building with white cable-stayed structures on the roof. Dark SUVs are parked in the foreground, and the sky is grey and cloudy. (3) The couple is now inside a large, brightly lit exhibition hall. The background is filled with colorful trade show booths, signage, and a large crowd of people walking around. The man points toward a booth with a green and white striped awning labeled '全家好賣市集'. (4) Close-up shots show hands holding various food samples. A piece of dark, braised beef on a toothpick is lifted from a white paper cup. A small cup of clear liquid is shown, and later, pieces of golden-brown toasted bread are displayed. The man and woman take turns eating these samples, showing exaggerated expressions of enjoyment and nodding. (5) A close-up of a smartphone screen shows the 'FamilyMart' app being opened and scrolled through. The interface displays a 'Good Sell Marketplace' section with various health food products like white wood ear mushroom drinks, each with prices and photos.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop BGM begins with a steady 4/4 beat. A male voice speaks enthusiastically with a friendly, high-pitched tone, accompanied by faint outdoor environmental hum. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the move indoors. The acoustic texture shifts to a large room resonance with moderate crowd chatter and background murmurs. (3) The BGM continues as a female voice joins in a lively conversational exchange. The vocal arousal is high. A subtle percussive 'click' sound is heard during close-ups of food being sampled. (4) The male speaker transitions to a more informative, narrative tone while explaining the app. The BGM maintains a consistent tempo. A soft 'ding' sound effect highlights the interaction with the smartphone screen. (5) The video ends with a synchronized vocal sign-off from both speakers over the upbeat BGM, which fades out quickly after the last word.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'FamilyMart Good Sell Marketplace' event at the Nangang Exhibition Center, showcasing the variety of food samples and the convenience of using the FamilyMart app to purchase these local specialty items online with free shipping.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creators explicitly visit the FamilyMart booth, show the brands, taste their products, and demonstrate how to use the specific app to buy them.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy, fast-paced vlog format typical of social media influencers to drive engagement and app downloads through on-site event attendance.
